exposure: Abdominal sacrocervicopexy with monofilament polypropylene mesh
cohort: The study included 72 patients diagnosed with pelvic organ prolapse (POP) who underwent abdominal sacrocervicopexy between 2008 and 2016.
finding: Eight patients who underwent abdominal sacrocervicopexy had healthy pregnancies and deliveries without any issues or complications.
mod_finding: Of the eight pregnant patients, one had a normal vaginal delivery and seven gave birth by cesarean section.
gest_age: Average of 38.5 weeks (range 35-40 weeks) at delivery
